privacy.title: Privacy, Cookies and Data Use Notice
privacy.intro: At Xafari we value your trust. This notice explains what information we collect, how we use it and the choices you have to stay in control.
privacyList: We only collect the information needed to create your account and personalise your Xafari experience.
Your progress and in-game settings are stored securely using encryption.
You can request changes or deletion of your data by contacting our support team.
cookiesList: We rely on essential cookies to remember your session together with your language and sound preferences.
These cookies are not shared with third parties nor used for advertising purposes.
You may disable cookies in your browser, although some features might stop working correctly.
dataUseList: Tailor the gameplay experience and show content that matches your progress.
Improve the platform performance and detect potential technical issues.
Send important communications about service updates or security topics.
privacy.contactDescription: If you have questions about this notice or want to exercise your privacy rights, write to privacy@xafari.com.

terms.title: Xafari Terms and Conditions
terms.intro: These terms govern the use of the Xafari app and outline the basic rules to enjoy the adventure safely and respectfully.
accountList: Provide real information so your avatar and progress reflect your experience.
You are responsible for keeping your login and device secure.
If you notice unauthorised use, let us know immediately so we can protect your account.
playList: Missions are narrative: they do not require dangerous or invasive actions.
Respect safety signs and follow staff instructions in any physical spaces.
Progress may be reset if misuse or cheating is detected.
conductList: Respect fellow players and collaborators; avoid offensive or discriminatory language.
Do not share content that infringes copyrights or others' privacy.
Follow the rules of each location you visit in and out of the game.
dataList: We use your data according to the Privacy Notice; you can consult it anytime from the menu.
Some missions may send notifications; adjust permissions on your device if you prefer.
We store your progress to sync it across sessions and devices.
terms.supportDescription: For questions or requests, email support@xafari.com and include your user and device.
